label: MC-004
note: SQL injection via string interpolation passed to FromSqlRaw: untrusted caller-supplied name is embedded directly in the SQL string instead of using a parameterized overload or FromSqlInterpolated, allowing arbitrary SQL execution. Bar is HIGH, not CRITICAL: High already blocks the PR (Critical/High -> request-changes), and MC-005 grades a comparable security defect (hardcoded secret) at HIGH — a lone CRITICAL here made this fixture the only one in the corpus that demanded the top tier for a blocking-either-way finding.
